Tablet of the Kings:
We who served the last king set this stone apart from its brothers, so that the gate stays shut. Under Teku-Sul the roots of every Hist meet, and the Eye sits where they meet and binds them. Set your hand to it where it sits, and strength runs down every root to every tree. Lift it from its place, and every tree is cut from every other, for good, and the weak among them die alone. The king would not trust either act to any one hand. So we sealed it.

content.text:
I took the second seal-stone from the drowned lowest hall of Gemin, which completed "The Vault's Stone". Nobody there would talk to me, and I didn't have to fight anyone.

The Tablet of the Kings says the Eye does opposite things depending on how it's used. Used where it sits at the Root, it strengthens every tree. Lifted from its place, it cuts every tree off from every other, and the weak ones die alone.

I now hold two of the three seal-stones. The third is in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, reached by boat near Noota Nara. After that, all three go into the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire.

Still unanswered: why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, and how Nesh-Deeka knows so much about the Unbound. I gave the game my final notes, including a reminder not to lift the Eye, and it has ended.
